item.title: Browns defensive coordinator hire Mike Rutenberg has no link to Jim Schwartz
item.description: Four finalists were in contention for the job of Browns defensive coordinator heading into the weekend just concluded. Head coach Todd Monken on Feb. 16 chose the only one with no ties to Jim Schwartz. Mike Rutenberg, 44, beat out Cory Undlin, Jason Tarver and Ephraim Banda to replace Schwartz, who resigned on Feb. 5 after three years as Browns defensive coordinator because he was not hired as head coach. item.title: Browns safety Ronnie Hickman out of hospital after New York mugging
item.description: Browns safety Ronnie Hickman was assaulted in the pre-dawn hours of Feb. 16 outside an upscale New York City. Hickman was injured in the altercation that occurred around 4:30 a.m., taken to a hospital and then released after being treated.
